context: Request: how many matters attributed to the White Collar & Investigations practice involved an issued litigation hold, and which. Rubric: seven matters (1016-00009, 1021-00008, 1032-00007, 1034-00001, 1039-00005, 1044-00007, 1045-00007), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts and lists all matter folders.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for attribution and hold terms times out; its rerun times out again (with a folder listing in parallel). The review flags that it was not narrowed, paged, backgrounded or rerun.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for hold, preservation, investigation and practice words, plus engagement and memo names; then a per-matter list of hold- and preservation-named files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: tighter path search for litigation-hold and preservation notices, then an extraction script reading attribution text from those matters' intake and engagement documents (about 247K characters). The review flags the file-name anchoring.

stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads attribution and hold documents of about a dozen candidate matters, with folder globs.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes six matters with attribution and hold documents, method and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: explicit path-existence check.

stages.stage: Finish the run

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: After its content scan timed out twice it relied on hold-named file searches, which never reached one needed matter whose hold evidence sits in other documents.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review named the timed-out scan and that it was not rerun, paged or backgrounded.
first_error.why: Its only content search over the store timed out twice and was never narrowed or rerun; the hold-named file searches it fell back on could not reach the matter whose hold evidence is not in a hold-named file.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Script over all paths for hold, preservation, white-collar, investigation, intake and practice words (about 92K characters).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a scan over a hand-picked list of candidate matters; attribution scans for the practice name (one fails with a script error).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide parallel scan of .docx files for practice attribution and hold language; after a timeout and broken split scripts it reruns in two halves and intersects attribution and hold matter lists.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (continued). Reads attribution and hold documents of the candidates in the intersection, with snippet scripts. The review flags the .docx-only scan and that hold-only matters were not checked for other attribution wording.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads documents of seven more attribution hits and runs file-count scripts; all excluded.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes six matters with attribution and hold documents, method and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Globs the six cited hold documents and re-reads the response.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its store-wide attribution scan read only .docx files, so one needed matter whose practice attribution appears in an email never entered the candidate set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review named the .docx-only scan and the unchecked hold-only matters.
first_error.why: The store-wide scan that fixed the candidate set read only .docx files, and the needed matter's practice attribution sits in an email, so the matter fell out of the attribution-and-hold intersection; the review named the .docx-only limit and the agent screened other matters instead.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find of folders and a sample of files, first 80 lines each.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all matter folders and files.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out twice (a file-name find for hold and practice words runs in parallel); reruns in four matter ranges to files, then filters the output for the exact practice-group phrase (13 matters). The review flags the exact-phrase filter.

stages.note: Keyword-filtered file listings of the 13 candidate matters.

stages.note: Reads attribution, engagement and hold documents of the 13 candidates and a snippet script. The review flags that one matter was excluded from its engagement letter alone.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Lists the files of four unresolved candidates and reads one document from three of them; the exclusions stand. The review flags absence-of-hold conclusions resting on file names and single reads.

stages.note: Writes five matters with attribution and hold documents, method and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Path-existence loop and re-read of the response.

stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: An exact-phrase attribution filter dropped one needed matter, and another it opened was excluded because it found only an instruction to circulate a hold.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review named the exact-phrase filter and the risk to differently worded attributions.
first_error.why: The range scans covered every matter, but the agent kept only matters whose text contained the exact practice-group phrase, which dropped a needed matter attributed in other wording; the review of this stage flagged the exact-phrase filter and the agent listed only the 13 matches.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review named this exclusion as resting on the engagement letter alone; the agent listed the folder and re-read the letter but kept the exclusion.
other_errors.why: It opened the needed matter's engagement letter and folder listing but excluded the matter because no separate hold notice was found, although the letter directs a hold (evidence seen at [62]-[80]).

divergence: All three runs found the matters whose hold notices are in hold-named documents and whose attribution is in documents, and all three missed the same matter, whose practice attribution sits in an email and whose hold evidence is not in a hold-named file; they missed it in different ways. T0's store-wide content scan timed out twice and was not rerun (the critic said so); it fell back to hold-named file searches, which never reached that matter (search miss). T1 completed a store-wide scan, but only over .docx files, so the matter's attribution was never seen and it was filtered out of the candidates; the critic named the .docx-only limit and the agent did not act on it (search miss). T2 ran the scan over all file types and the matter surfaced and was opened, but the agent excluded it because it found only an engagement-letter instruction to circulate a hold; the critic flagged this exclusion and the agent re-read the same letter and kept it (under-inclusion). T2 also lost a second matter through an exact-phrase attribution filter that the critic had flagged (over-narrow filter, its first error).
